query:
SELECT m.sponsorId, COUNT(*) as meetingCount, MIN(m.timeSlot) as minSlot, MAX(m.timeSlot) as maxSlot
FROM meetings m
GROUP BY m.sponsorId
ORDER BY m.sponsorId;
